item.description: The Flask hook implementation doesn't correctly identify and instrument Flask applications. The hook is not receiving Flask app instances properly from the generic hook mechanism, and the detection logic fails to recognize Flask applications defined in test modules.
item.contract: The hook_flask function must properly detect Flask app instances by checking for Flask-specific attributes (route, view_functions, error_handlers) and hook all view functions and error handlers associated with those apps. The function should work with Flask apps passed through the generic hook mechanism and correctly apply instrumentation to route handlers and error handlers.
